title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 14.0 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 14.0 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users to create issues with locked discussions without having the required permissions due to improper authorization checks. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
